name: nodebase-ai-workflow-builder
description: Visual AI workflow automation platform with drag-and-drop workflow builder, AI integrations, event-driven execution, and secure credential management.

paragraphs: Visual AI workflow automation platform for designing, orchestrating, and monitoring multi-step LLM and API pipelines.
Live Application • Get Started as Guest • Architecture • Local Setup • Security

NodeBase is a full-stack visual workflow builder that connects manual triggers and incoming webhooks to Large Language Models (OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude), outbound HTTP REST APIs, and team messaging channels (Slack, Discord).
features: Interactive DAG Canvas: Built on @xyflow/react with custom node components, connection handles, mini-map navigation, and keyboard accessibility.
Graph Integrity & Sanitization: Automatically strips self-loops, dangling edges referencing removed nodes, and duplicate connections before saving.
Cycle Detection: Validates workflows with topological sorting (toposort) so cyclic graphs are rejected before execution.
Zero-Barrier Entry: Clicking Get Started as Guest on / opens /workflows/demo directly without redirecting to /login or /signup.

Preloaded Demo Pipeline: Loads the Weather AI Summary (Demo) pipeline (Manual Trigger → HTTP Request → Gemini) so visitors can inspect node configurations, add new nodes, connect edges, and edit prompts immediately.

whatItDoes.text: Visual AI workflow automation platform for designing, orchestrating, and monitoring multi-step LLM and API pipelines.

requirements.text: For Technical Evaluators & Visitors: Click Get Started as Guest on the live application to open the interactive React Flow builder immediately in the browser—no account creation or login barrier required.
Zero-Barrier Entry: Clicking Get Started as Guest on / opens /workflows/demo directly without redirecting to /login or /signup.
> Tip: Polar billing (POLARACCESSTOKEN), OAuth providers (GITHUB, GOOGLE), and webhook secrets (STRIPEWEBHOOKSECRET, GOOGLEFORMWEBHOOKSECRET) are optional for local setup.
External Provider Configuration: Executing OpenAI, Gemini, or Anthropic nodes requires the signed-in user to add a valid provider API key under /credentials.
